source_tree: dirty; baseline and candidate were built from the same workspace, with this four-file change as their only difference

change.behavior: Derive the legacy Function.prototype caller/arguments restriction from the active Function metadata already passed to frame activation, instead of resolving the callable heap cell and looking up its ProgramStore metadata again. The existing restriction predicate is shared by all callers.
change.semantic_boundary: The original_arguments snapshot remains intact for active, reflectable sloppy functions. It is observable through Function.prototype.arguments, preserves extra arguments and recursive activations, and remains a GC root across suspension.
change.binding_time: strictness, constructibility, and class-constructor status are immutable Function metadata available before activation

production_build.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo build --locked --profile production -p quench-runtime --bin quench
